primary_endpoint: At 52 weeks: histological improvement in NAS without worsening of fibrosis; and steatohepatitis resolution without worsening of fibrosis plus histological improvement in NAS.
efficacy_outcome: Reported counts for the two endpoints were 42 vs 9 and 29 vs 6 for TVB-2640 50 mg vs placebo, respectively. Reported p-values were 0.0001–0.0035 for the first endpoint and 0.0022–0.0173 for the second.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 13/112 participants receiving TVB-2640 50 mg and 3/56 receiving placebo; no deaths in either group.
